text:
Elaine C.: Heads-up — seeing a token-level latency regression on dedicated/private workloads after the kernel selector change. p50 unchanged, p95 up ~18% on long sequences.
Matt R.: ugh, when did this appear? Canary last night?
Elaine C.: First appeared 2026-08-12 in our canary run. Stack shows more kernel switches during generation. Likely the sampler/prefetch heuristic causing extra KV cache misses.
Sanjay K.: Could be the new prefetch sampler that probes both fused-attn and generic kernels. It falls back too often. I can share a flamegraph.
Zoe L.: If KV cache misses spike we see full re-compute of past key/value -> token latency hit. Are we logging per-token cache-hit? Not yet.
perf-bot: Profiling report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/perf/reports/1824501123
Matt R.: Needed: token-level breakdown panels in Grafana (cache-hit vs compute vs kernel-switch). Also per-route KPIs for /generate vs /chat.
Elaine C.: Agreed. For private/VPC customers we need an export format that their Prometheus can scrape without opening extra endpoints. Suggest we add a push-gateway job that writes to a file for air-gapped import.
Sanjay K.: Proposed prometheus config snippet for airgap import:
``
# pushgateway scrape for air-gapped customer
job_name: 'redwood_airgap_export'
static_configs:
  - targets: ['localhost:9091']
```
Zoe L.: For on-prem we already surface /metrics over unix socket — maybe provide a helper that converts to a prometheus textfile and a tarball they can upload.
Matt R.: UX: one-shot export + delta exports. Customers sometimes want weekly exports to ingest into their Grafana.
Elaine C.: Also need labels: route, model_family, kernel_variant, batch_size, kv_prefetch_policy, customer_id (only for private). No PII.
Sanjay K.: I've got flamegraphs and a differential profile comparing pre-change and post-change. Uploading short summary to thread.
perf-bot: Diff profile: p95 tokens increased by 22% for seq_len>2048 when sampler enabled.
Elaine C.: Plan: 1) revert sampler fallback order to prefer stable kernel for long context, 2) add token-level cache-hit metric (counter + gauge), 3) dashboard panels for per-route p50/p95/p99 token latencies, 4) airgap exporter prototype.
Zoe L.: I'll owner dashboard PR. Matt can we have a shedding policy for overloaded kernels? maybe dynamic batching cap.
Matt R.: Yep. Adding a 'kernel_shed' circuit per-host. Also tuning continuous-batcher to avoid overfilling for small-latency SLO routes.
Elaine C.: Great. Action items: Sanjay -> PR with sampler revert + tests, Zoe -> grafana panels and prom queries, Matt -> circuit + batcher tuning, Ops -> wire up file-export helper for customers.
Sanjay K.: Starting work now. Will ping when patch is up for review.
Matt R.: Thanks, all. :thumbsup:
prometheus-bot: New exporter image pushed: registry.redwood/internal/prom-airgap:1.2.0
Elaine C.: tagging customer success to coordinate export options with early customers. @cs-team
